'''Íþróttafélagið Fylkir''' ({{IPA|is|ˈiːˌθrouhtaˌfjɛːˌlaijɪð ˈfɪl̥cɪr̥}}, {{lit|Fylkir Sports Club}}{{efn|''Íþróttafélagið'' is the [[Definiteness|definite form]] of ''Íþróttafélag'', meaning "the sports club".}}) is a [[multi-sport club]] in [[Árbær]], in the eastern part of [[Reykjavík]], the capital of Iceland. It features departments in [[Association football|football]], [[Team handball|handball]], [[volleyball]], [[gymnastics]] and [[karate]]."}}
